text:
nina_sales: Quick thread: EU fintech asks if we can run a 10-day EU-only POC on Hosted (no Dedicated) and supply evidence for procurement: netflow, KMS region logs, and sub-processor assurances. They also want an estimate for the cost to move to Dedicated later.
raj_se: short: Hosted supports tenant region affinity but not absolute contractual residency. We can do a timeboxed policy to minimize cross-region egress and produce logs. For legal guarantees, Dedicated/Private + BYOK required.
paul_ops: Ops can enable a manual routing pin for the tenant to eu-west-1 and disable automatic fallback for the POC window. We'll enable netflow capture and a scoped KMS audit mode. This is manual and needs a support ticket + on-call signoff.
ida_compliance: compliance: we can provide exported KMS-region audit CSVs for the scoped key and netflow CSVs. We can also provide a sub-processor annex marking any control planes that are multi-region. We cannot sign a perpetual "no egress" clause for Hosted; only for Dedicated/Private.
nina_sales: they asked for a simple header example to show engineers how we'll steer traffic.
raj_se: sample header to demonstrate region hint:```
POST /v1/chat/completions
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}
x-tenant-id: fintech-poc
x-region-hint: eu-west-1
```
We will server-side pin routing for the POC.
tim_finance: ballpark cost notes for procurement: Hosted POC + ops support = usage charges + one-time ops engagement (~$2-8k depending on on-call/time). Dedicated migration typically 3x unit cost vs hosted in many cases; provisioning lead time 4-8 weeks. We'll produce a more precise quote after model/commit details.
paul_ops: deliverables at POC end: 1) netflow CSV for tenant IPs, 2) KMS audit CSV for the scoped key, 3) processing-path diagram, 4) sub-processor annex. We will not share raw pcaps.
ida_compliance: suggested RFP wording: "Redwood offers tenant-scoped regional affinity for Hosted deployments and can implement a timeboxed operational policy to constrain processing to EU capacity for POCs. Redwood will supply operational evidence (netflow exports, KMS-region audit logs, and processing-path diagrams) for the POC. For contractual and cryptographic guarantees of exclusive in-region processing, Redwood provides Dedicated or Private deployments with customer-managed keys (BYOK/HSM)."
paul_ops: operational note: to run the POC we need written approval from the customer with the POC window and acceptance of manual-scope revert. Ops will schedule within 3 business days after approval.
ops-bot: ticket RD-POC-1555 created and assigned to @paul_ops and @raj_se, target start in 3 business days.
nina_sales: great — i'll send the customer's questionnaire here when it arrives and tag @ida_compliance for the RFP text review. Thanks team :thumbsup:
